isolated_test_cause_and_fix.cause: The earlier temporary Kvantum files were placed flat under XDG_CONFIG_HOME/Kvantum. Kvantum 1.1.4 searches a named subdirectory and could not load that theme, so QStyle used default 12px metrics and a small fallback arrow.
isolated_test_cause_and_fix.test_only_fix: Placed the generated Kvantum config/SVG under XDG_CONFIG_HOME/Kvantum/DomainOS-SR10-4-KDE/; no system or personal configuration changed.
